title: J1.1: identity bootstrap races the deferred runtime loader; failing manager varies
step_description: Daniel and Nik sign in through SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE and choose their players
steps: Run CI browser-journey setup on the pinned current-main checkout: npm ci; install Firebase 12.17.0, rules-unit-testing 5.0.1 and firebase-admin 14.2.0 without saving dependency files; build composed Rules and run the zero-billing assertion.
Set CMS_CHROMIUM_MULTI_CONTEXT=1 and a distinct CMS_BROWSER_JOURNEY_ARTIFACTS directory per run.

Run npx --yes firebase-tools@15.28.1 emulators:exec --config tests/browser/support/firebase.browser-journey.json --only auth,firestore --project demo-cms-browser-journey "CMS_SHOWDOWN_LENGTH=3 node tests/browser/two-manager-browser-journey.cjs" three times with fresh emulator processes.
Observe signIn() clicking #newShowdown and waiting 30 seconds for SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE.
expected: Each fresh manager context opens the identity dialog from #newShowdown, signs in, selects Daniel or Nik, and reaches J1.1 with both identities ready.
actual: All three unmodified CI journeys passed J0.1 and J0.2, then timed out waiting for SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE at J1.1. Run 1 signed in Daniel and failed on Nik. Runs 2 and 3 failed on Daniel. The failed manager was on createShowdown with no identity badge or visible identity overlay.

root_cause: index.html loads deferred showdown.js before optionalModules.js and app.js. During deferred script execution document.readyState can already be interactive. initializeOnlinePlayerEntry() sets __cmsOnlinePlayerEntryBootstrap=true and then schedules start() with setTimeout(0), allowing it to run before the later scripts define loadRuntimeScript and reportApplicationError. ensureOnlinePlayerIdentitySurface() throws Online runtime loader unavailable; the catch uses the still-absent optional error reporter and loses the error. The bootstrap flag stays true and no automatic retry loads onlinePlayerIdentity.js. Its capture-phase gameplay guard is absent, so screens.js routes #newShowdown directly to createShowdown. This explains the blank badge, missing sign-in dialog, empty page-error lists, and which manager fails changing with script delivery timing.

root_cause_confidence: High: source dependency ordering and a separate controlled browser observation support the cause; the three official journey runs were not instrumented or altered.

supplemental_diagnostic.scope: Two fresh-page startup observations on the same main; not extra journey runs. No emulator process was running, and no sign-in or gameplay write was performed. The existing localhost emulator switch and local Firebase SDK interception were used.
supplemental_diagnostic.change: Delay only the network response for the unchanged js/optionalModules.js by 400 ms in Playwright; preserve every source file.
supplemental_diagnostic.control_result: Identity loaded, signed-out status, sign-in dialog present, page stayed on mainMenu.
supplemental_diagnostic.delayed_result: At 32 ms the bootstrap latch was true while both loader and reporter were absent. At 432 ms the loader/reporter existed but identity was still absent. After Start, createShowdown was visible with no sign-in button or overlay.

output.kind: supplemental startup observation; not an additional journey run

fix.change: Schedule identity initialization after its deferred dependencies are ready, and permit recovery after initialization failure. Keep error reporting available and preserve the gameplay identity guard. This is a recommendation only; no game code was changed.

limits: No checkpoint after J1.1 was reached in this sweep.
No claim about later gameplay, physical-device behavior, production-account acceptance or SSJR/MDP credit.
